versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- Chat with your tripmates: a group chat for each trip, and one-to-one chats
  with everyone you share a trip with. Open it from the chat icon at the top
  of the Trip page, or from Message on a person's page.
- Voice and video calls between tripmates. On Android an incoming call rings
  like a phone call, full screen and on the lock screen, even with TripSplit
  closed. Missed calls show as a notification and in the chat.
- Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted: only the people in the chat can
  read or hear them, not TripSplit or Google. Tap a name in a chat to compare
  security codes.

### Notes
- Only people who share a trip can message or call each other.
- On iPhone, calls ring only while TripSplit is open.
- Your tripmates need this version too, and to open it once, before they can
  get your messages and calls.
